newsitem.title: USA: Flexsteel Industries to buy Dygert Seating.
newsitem.headline: Flexsteel Industries to buy Dygert Seating.

text.p: Flexsteel Industries Inc said on Tuesday it signed an agreement to acquire the assets of Dygert Seating Inc for an undisclosed price.
Dygert Seating, which is operating under Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection, will allow Flexsteel to expand its line of van conversion and specialty seating, the company said.
Flexsteel said the proposed purchase is subject to the approval of a federal bankruptcy court.
Flexsteel makes upholstered seating products for the home, vehicles and institutions.
Its shares closed up 1/2 Tuesday at 11-1/2.
